Note: Interface Automata notation is not typically represented in JSON, and the above JSON structure is a conceptual representation of how the test cases would be organized. Actual Interface Automata would require a more specialized format, often involving state diagrams or similar visual representations, which are beyond the scope of this text-based interface. The above JSON format is designed to meet the requirements for readability and test case structuring as requested. For Interface Automata, one would typically use a graphical or tabular representation to show states, transitions, and conditions for each test case.
